maya: quick heads-up — onboarding hf model 'lex-13' -> redwood conversion, our reranker MRR dropped after conversion + quantization experiments
omar: ugh. numbers?
maya: baseline eval on devset before conversion: MRR=0.412, P@1=0.352
maya: after hf->rw conversion (no quant): MRR=0.398
maya: after conversion + int8 quant profile: MRR=0.387 (significant for reranker) :frowning:
sasha: that's a noticeable regression. did tokenization change? cls pooling?
maya: ran a quick token dump — seems the HF tokenizer and RW converter disagree on special tokens + truncation. HF output had leading <cls> only once, RW-converted embed pool was prepending cls AND appending sep sometimes
jing: could be our pooling mapping. conversion script maps `pooling_strategy` -> `cls` but also injects `cls_token` into inputs for old chat templates. double-insert on older chat template variants.
omar: can you paste the config snippet from the converted model?
maya: sure:
```
{"model_type":"lex","tokenizer_config":{"add_bos_token":true,"cls_token":"<cls>","sep_token":"<sep>","truncation":"longest_first","pooling":"cls"},"quant":{"mode":"int8","calibration":"kld"}}
```
jing: truncation=longest_first + add_bos true is suspicious for embedding pooling. we usually do `truncation: only_first` for reranker embeddings to keep CLS stable at position 0. longest_first can drop the first tokens, shifting cls index.
sasha: exactly. if cls gets shifted out or duplicated, embedding pooling (CLS) will pick wrong vector. also padding/truncation side matters: we expect cls at index 0.
maya: i diffed token ids: HF tokenized sample -> [101, 200, 300, 102] (101=cls, 102=sep)
maya: RW-converted -> [101, 200, 300, 102, 101] (extra 101 at end)
omar: that explains off-by-one pooling pick, plus our kv-cache offsets during generation/quantization alignment could be off.
sasha: quick mitigation: change conversion to not insert cls/sep if tokenizer already has them, and set truncation to `only_first`. Also normalize `add_prefix_space` behavior.
maya: I'm going to patch conversion script:
```
# pseudo
if tokenizer.cls_token in tokens: do_not_prepend_cls=True
config.truncation='only_first'
config.pooling='cls'  # but assert cls at idx 0
```

ci-bot: conversion-job/lex13-1772504321 finished: status=success, artifacts=/artifacts/lex13/1772504321 :rocket:
sasha: after fix, rerun quant tests with the same calibration set and compare embedding cosine/rr metrics, also run rank eval (MRR, MAP)
jing: add automated tokenization parity check in onboarding CI: sample N texts, compare hf_tokens vs rw_tokens modulo allowed normalizations. fail if special token counts differ.
omar: agreed. also add a fast smoke eval that computes mean cosine on a small set and fails if drop > 1.5% relative.
maya: will push PR with changes + new CI checks, then re-run int8 pipeline. planning to re-eval by EOD. thanks all. :pray:
